title: Fix overly strict cursor validation in findPaginated
description: findPaginated rejects cursors starting with 'eyJ' as 'tampered or expired'. This is too strict — legitimate base64 cursors from some systems may start with this prefix. Either remove magic string check, make it configurable, or use proper cursor signing/verification.

title: Automate fix-esm-imports.ts in build pipeline
description: ParqueDB dist/ is built with moduleResolution:bundler (extensionless imports). scripts/fix-esm-imports.ts must run after every rebuild or imports break in other modules. Need: integrate fix-esm-imports into build script (postbuild hook), add CI check that imports are correct.

title: Add automatic event log compaction
description: Events append forever with no automatic archival. Event log grows unbounded, hydration slows on cold start. archiveEvents() exists but is not scheduled. Need: background alarm-based job to compact events, configurable retention policy, automatic archival to R2.
close_reason: Implemented: automatic event log compaction with safe verify-then-delete

title: Document sharding strategy and capacity planning
description: Write operational runbooks for: type-based sharding (Users DO, Orders DO), time-based sharding (hourly buckets), hash-based sharding. Include: when to shard (p99>500ms, >20req/s), how to migrate data, capacity planning for write throughput (~30 writes/sec per DO), storage limits.
close_reason: Implemented: 831-line sharding and capacity planning documentation
